source_row.rationale: Troponin levels typically begin to rise within a few hours of myocardial injury (though not necessarily immediately at symptom onset), peak within roughly 12-24 hours, and can remain elevated for several days afterward. This timing pattern makes serial troponin measurements (rather than a single value) useful for both diagnosing myocardial infarction and monitoring the trend over time.
